description: This file defines a Flutter widget named InviteFriendsFragment, which provides UI for inviting friends via referral code sharing, copying referral code, and sending SMS invites. It mirrors functionality from a Kotlin fragment and includes UI components such as buttons, text, icons, and styling.

classes.name: InviteFriendsFragment
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that presents a UI for inviting friends, sharing referral codes, copying referral code, and sending SMS invitations.
